name: 陈丹英
major: NF-κB信号通路与天然免疫信号转导
college: 北京大学生命科学学院

papers: DSTYK phosphorylates STING at late endosomes to promote STING signaling.
UNC13D inhibits STING signaling by attenuating its oligomerization on the endoplasmic reticulum.
An E3 ligase-independent function for RNF123 in RIG-I like receptors-mediated antiviral signaling.
Ring finger protein 166 potentiates RNA virus-induced interferon-β production via enhancing the ubiquitination of TRAF3 and TRAF6.
Negative regulation of RIG-I-mediated innate antiviral signaling by SEC14L1.
ARF-like protein 16 (ARL16) inhibits RIG-I by binding with its C-terminal domain in a GTP-dependent manner.
REUL is a novel E3 ubiquitin ligase and stimulator of retinoic-acid-inducible gene-I.
WDR34 is a novel TAK1-associated suppressor of the IL-1R/TLR3/TLR4-induced NF-kappaB activation pathway.
Syntenin negatively regulates TRAF6-mediated IL-1R/TLR4 signaling.
Negative feedback regulation of cellular antiviral signaling by RBCK1-mediated degradation of IRF3.
paper_description: DSTYK在晚期内体上磷酸化STING以促进STING信号传导。
UNC13D通过减弱STING在内质网上的寡聚化来抑制STING信号传导。
RNF123在RIG-I样受体介导的抗病毒信号传导中具有不依赖E3连接酶的功能。
环指蛋白166通过增强TRAF3和TRAF6的泛素化来增强RNA病毒诱导的干扰素-β产生。
SEC14L1对RIG-I介导的天然抗病毒信号的负调控。
ARF样蛋白16 (ARL16)以GTP依赖的方式与其C端结构域结合来抑制RIG-I。
REUL是一种新型的E3泛素连接酶和视黄酸诱导基因-I的刺激因子。
WDR34是IL-1R/TLR3/TLR4诱导的NF-κB激活通路的新型TAK1相关抑制因子。
Syntenin负调控TRAF6介导的IL-1R/TLR4信号传导。
RBCK1介导的IRF3降解对细胞抗病毒信号的负反馈调节。
